newsitem.title: USA: Preferred Income stake raised by group.
newsitem.headline: Preferred Income stake raised by group.

text.p: A group including Horejsi Enterprises Inc said Friday it raised its stake in Preferred Income Management Fund to 1,744,300 common shares or 18.52 percent of the total outstanding.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought 156,100 additional shares of the Pasadena, Calif.,-based company between November 4 and 21 at prices ranging from $14.375 to $14.50 a share.
Preferred Income Management is a closed-end mutual fund concern. Closed-end funds have a limited number of shares.
